senses.gloss:
लि लि, इस्, m. (a doubtful word, meaning
according to some) weariness, fatigue; loss, destruc-
tion; end, term; equality, sameness; a bracelet.

ली 1. ली, cl. 9. P. लिनाति (this form not
usually found), to adhere; to obtain (?);
cl. 1. P. लयति (not usually found), to melt, liquefy,
dissolve; cl. 4. A. लीयते (this is the usual form),
लिल्ये, लेष्यति or लास्यति, लेष्यते or लास्यते,
अलेष्ट or अलास्त, लेतुम्, लातुम्, to cling or press
closely, join or adhere firmly, adhere or stick to-
gether, cling to, embrace; to lie, recline, lie or rest
upon, sit upon, dwell in, stay in, haunt, lurk in, hide
in, cower down in; to be viscous or sticky; to be
solvable, to be dissolved; to be absorbed in; to be
devoted to; to disappear, vanish: Pass. लीयते, Aor.
अलायि: Caus. (generally with prep. वि), -लापयति or
-लाययति or -लीनयति or -लालयति, to melt, liquefy,
dissolve, &c., (see वि-ली; according to Pāṇ. I. 3, 70,
the form लापयते in Ātmane-pada is used in the
sense of ‘to obtain honour,’ ‘cause to be honoured’):
Desid. लिलीषति, -ते: Intens. लेलीयते, लेलयीति,
लेलेति (for लेलायति, which some consider an intensive
form of a rt. ली, see लेलाय); [cf. Gr. λεῖμαξ: Lat.
līmus, po-lire, linere; according to some, liqueo,
liquo: Old Germ. lim, leim: Angl. Sax. lime,
lam.]

2. ली, ईस्, f. clinging to, adhering, embracing, &c.;
liquefying, melting; = चपल; [cf. लेलाय.]
